section_summary.extract_value: This is a single study examining associations between positive body image and sexual attitudes in U.S. adults. An online sample of 151 women and 164 men (total N=315) completed measures of sexual liberalism, attitudes toward unconventional sexual practices, and positive body image indices including body appreciation. Regression analyses showed that higher body appreciation was significantly associated with greater sexual liberalism and more positive attitudes toward unconventional sexual practices in both genders.
